name: distrobuilder
description: Builds distrobuilder, the image building tool for Incus and LXC, from upstream's signature-verified release source and installs it with the tools it runs, in a container that holds the SYS_ADMIN capability the tool needs to build container images.

version.description: distrobuilder release to build: 'latest', the release upstream marks as latest, or a release such as 3.4.0 (a leading 'v' is accepted; 3.3.1 or later).

vmSupport.description: Install the tools 'distrobuilder build-incus --vm' runs (Btrfs, ext4, and FAT file systems, GPT partitioning, qemu-img, udev). Building a virtual machine image also needs a privileged container; see the notes.

windowsSupport.description: Install the tools 'distrobuilder repack-windows' runs (hivex, wimlib, genisoimage). Repacking also needs a privileged container; see the notes.
